title: ESAM exp2 frozen shared
why: Official ESAM++ recipe. Same teacher, same frames, same split, same 110 minute budget as exp1, but every shared layer (super point pooling, query decoder, merge head) stays frozen with its published ESAM-E weights and only the TinyExpert backbone is trained. The pretrained decoder is then never dragged away by a random backbone, which is the hypothesis this experiment tests.
name: ESAM++ Tiny student - shared layers frozen
